description.narrative: The Commonwealth approach to a Just Energy Transition is one that delivers resilience — economic, environmental, and social — for all nations, leaving no one behind by providing integrated support to member states via 1) Technical Assistance for strengthened policy, taxation, legal, institutional and regulatory frameworks. For ~60years ComSec has provided CMCs with end-to-end advisory support from policy formulation to legal drafting with integrated capacity building. This is a core area of experise which CMCs highly value vs. other service providers' short-term transactional and commercially driven basis. 2) Institutional capacity building. “on the job” mentoring/coaching with CMCs where TA is provided, development of knowledge products and resources (which can be subsequently used in delivery of TA including in partnership with others) and operationalising of governing institutions. 3) Inclusive international Frameworks/Advocacy and Convening: Supporting CMCs in development of international frameworks on energy and natural resoruces to ensure inclusive perspectives esp the voice of vulnerable CMCs are represented. ComSec given diverse membership is known for focus on consensus builder and in heightened geopolitical landscape can be a powerful convener, amplifier,knowldge-sharing and solutions broker esp via the Commonwealth Sustainable Energy Transitions Agenda (CSET). 4) Crowding in Finance for the Just Transition – accelerating RE financing through bilateral technical assistance, Programme partnerships (Environment and Economic) and external partners 5) Empowering Gender and Youth in energy value chains especially increasing opportunities for employment and businesses
